title: pre-meeting-scrapbook-olivia-ng-apr07-2026
content:
Quick note: using this as my messy brain dump before the 1:1 with Olivia (30m). Keep it conversational; prioritize unblockers and growth.

Agenda (30m)
- 0-5m: personal check-in (non-work: moving? weekend?)
- 5-12m: immediate blockers / ticket triage (ENG-4821, KV cache flakiness; infra tickets)
- 12-20m: progress on current work + data points (latency SLOs, rollout plan for quantized models)
- 20-26m: career / mentorship (promo readiness, stretch project, learning plan)
- 26-30m: next actions + sync points (who, when)

Top priorities to discuss
- KV cache regressions: Olivia reported intermittent slowdowns when cache miss rate spikes. Confirm current repro steps, who owns the test harness, and whether we can get a hotfix in next patch release.
- Canary rollout for 13B quantized variant next week: confirm readiness checklist. Need her sign-off on perf validation and rollback plan.
- Oncall coverage next rotation: she asked to swap dates (Apr 21 -> Apr 28). Check with Maya.

Data / talking points to have ready
- 95th pct latency: 180ms (last week) -> goal 150ms. Recent change in batching config increased tail latency by ~10-15ms.
- Token throughput for her endpoint: avg 4.8k tokens/s, peak 7.1k tokens/s.
- Error budget: 3.2% throttles over quota for route /v1/generate in the last 7d.

Questions I want to ask Olivia
- Is the KV cache repro deterministic? Steps? Can I pair to reproduce in staging today?
- Who should I loop in for kernel selection testing (research infra or serving-runtime)?
- How comfortable are you with owning the canary: do you want me to take lead on rollback playbook?
- Career: what are 2 signal projects you want added to your promo packet? Any feedback for me on visibility/support?

Notes to self / phrasing suggestions (keep these short)
- "Great progress on the quantized model — let's make sure perf validation is exhaustive before canary. I trust your judgement on the rollout cadence."
- If KV repro looks like infra, escalate to platform-eng immediately and draft a minimal PR to show the fix surface.
- Offer 2 blocks of undisturbed time next sprint (4h each) for focus work.

Action items (owner / ETA)
- Olivia: run deterministic KV repro and paste steps into JIRA ENG-4821 (ETA: 2026-04-09)
- Diego (me): schedule a 60m pairing session in staging for repro (ETA: 2026-04-08)
- Olivia: finalize perf validation checklist for canary and attach perf graphs to PR #321 (ETA: 2026-04-10)
- Diego: reach out to Maya to confirm oncall swap and update calendar (ETA: 2026-04-08)
- Both: decide canary rollback criteria doc and link to runbook (ETA: 2026-04-09)

Career / growth notes
- Olivia: interested in lead-level ownership of a cross-team reliability project (good for promo). Suggest small leadership signals: run a cross-team retro, own postmortem rollout.
- Training: recommend she join the kernel-optimization brown bag next Tuesday (internal invite) and shadow Sasha for a perf deep-dive.
- Mentorship: propose monthly 1-hr pairing on design docs (I'll block recurring time if she wants).

Open questions / to file later
- Headcount ask: does she need another IC for Q3? She mentioned backlog on long-running experiments. Get numbers for predictions.
- Any blockers on infra quotas for dedicated pools? If yes, escalate to infra-quant team.

Praising to call out
- "Really appreciate how you triaged the production issue last Friday — kept the incident small and documented the mitigation clearly."
- Specific callout: PR #309 (service metrics) was tidy; recommend highlighting that in the weekly eng update.

Meeting follow-up template (quick email)
- Subject: 1:1 follow-up: action items + next steps\- Body bullets: summarize 3 actions, owners, deadlines; link to ENG-4821 and PR #321; propose next pairing time.

Misc scratch / yellow flags
- She sounded low-energy in last check-in; might be nearing burnout. Offer time off or lighter oncall.
- Recently pulled several late nights; ask about sustainable load.

End-of-doc reminders (for me)
- Update my manager sync with any promo-ready artifacts she gives me (CV, project blurbs).
- Add one-line progress to team's weekly status doc if canary goes green.
- Circle back next 1:1 on Apr 21 (tentative) to review follow-ups.
